title: waterfall template variables
description: Values for templates/waterfall.md.j2 and templates/waterfall.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from waterfall.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

biggest_over_budget_segment.title: Biggest over budget segment
biggest_over_budget_segment.description: Which single segment is furthest over its budget? Name one; a report that names three is a report nobody acts on.

cache_hit_rate.title: Cache hit rate
cache_hit_rate.description: What share of requests in this window hit the prefill cache? It is the single biggest reason two otherwise identical windows disagree.

dec_budget.title: Dec budget
dec_budget.description: How many milliseconds are allocated to decode? This is the segment output length moves, so check the budget against the length you actually emit.

dec_p50.title: Dec p50
dec_p50.description: What was the p50 decode time, in milliseconds?

dec_p95.title: Dec p95
dec_p95.description: What was the p95 decode time, in milliseconds?

dec_status.title: Dec status
dec_status.description: Is decode under, at, or over its budget?

feature_name.description: Which feature's latency is this? One feature per waterfall - averaging two call paths together hides the slow one behind the fast one.

n_samples.title: N samples
n_samples.description: How many requests are in that window? A p95 over a few hundred samples moves under you; say the number so a reader can judge it.

owner_full_name.description: Who owns this feature's latency budget? One named human who can accept or refuse the recommendation at the bottom of this report.

pc_budget.title: Pc budget
pc_budget.description: How many milliseconds are allocated to cold prefill?

pc_p50.title: Pc p50
pc_p50.description: What was the p50 cold prefill time, in milliseconds - the requests that missed the cache?

pc_p95.title: Pc p95
pc_p95.description: What was the p95 cold prefill time, in milliseconds?

pc_status.title: Pc status
pc_status.description: Is cold prefill under, at, or over its budget?

ph_budget.title: Ph budget
ph_budget.description: How many milliseconds are allocated to prefill on a cache hit?

ph_p50.title: Ph p50
ph_p50.description: What was the p50 prefill time on a cache hit, in milliseconds?

ph_p95.title: Ph p95
ph_p95.description: What was the p95 prefill time on a cache hit, in milliseconds?

ph_status.title: Ph status
ph_status.description: Is prefill-on-hit under, at, or over its budget?

pp_budget.title: Pp budget
pp_budget.description: How many milliseconds are allocated to post-processing?

pp_p50.title: Pp p50
pp_p50.description: What was the p50 post-processing time, in milliseconds?

pp_p95.title: Pp p95
pp_p95.description: What was the p95 post-processing time, in milliseconds?

pp_status.title: Pp status
pp_status.description: Is post-processing under, at, or over its budget?

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: What should be changed first, and what does it buy in milliseconds? Tie the recommendation to the segment named above or explain why not.

sla_value_ms.title: Sla value ms
sla_value_ms.description: What p95 latency, in milliseconds, is this feature committed to? The number a breach is measured against, not the number you would like.

tool_budget.title: Tool budget
tool_budget.description: How many milliseconds are allocated to tool calls in total?

tool_p50.title: Tool p50
tool_p50.description: What was the p50 time across all tool calls, in milliseconds?

tool_p95.title: Tool p95
tool_p95.description: What was the p95 time across all tool calls, in milliseconds? One slow third-party call usually lives here.

tool_status.title: Tool status
tool_status.description: Are tool calls under, at, or over their budget?

ttfb_budget.title: Ttfb budget
ttfb_budget.description: How many milliseconds of the total budget are allocated to time to first byte?

ttfb_p50.title: Ttfb p50
ttfb_p50.description: What was the p50 time to first byte, in milliseconds?

ttfb_p95.title: Ttfb p95
ttfb_p95.description: What was the p95 time to first byte, in milliseconds?

ttfb_status.title: Ttfb status
ttfb_status.description: Is time to first byte under, at, or over its budget?

window_end.title: Window end
window_end.description: When does the measurement window end?

window_start.title: Window start
window_start.description: When does the measurement window start? Percentiles from a window that spans a deploy describe two systems, not one.
